components.evidence: By construction aggregate open long equals aggregate open short. OI can measure outstanding risk and capacity for forced flow, not initiating side.
components.next_test: normalize OI notional by depth/ADV and combine with signed flow, funding/basis, participant class and liquidation distance.

components.evidence: Price/OI quadrants cannot distinguish new longs from new shorts without signed/participant data.
Long liquidations force sales and short liquidations force buys, but observed liquidation generally occurs after a trigger.
components.next_test: pre-liquidation leverage-to-depth, liquidation-distance clusters and origin trigger.

components.evidence: Can distinguish long build, short build, covering, liquidation and mixed build by participant class; weekly lag limits exact timing.
components.next_test: walk-forward commodity/FX outcomes with curve, inventory and release timestamps.

components.evidence: 125,529 registered price/volume claim records produced zero production survivors.
components.next_test: do not add more price-only formulas without a new causal observable.

components.evidence: Short-interest/institutional-ownership interactions recur in historical maintained factor-pair stress survivors, but not yet point-in-time stock proof.
components.next_test: fresh short interest, borrow fee, utilization, lendable supply, institutional ownership and microcap/capacity filters.

components.evidence: V5.8 gross candidates and SNDK causal reconstruction point to revisions, guidance, pricing and customer qualification rather than price/OI alone.
components.next_test: fresh point-in-time analyst and filing-based expectation reconstruction.

components.evidence: Oil case shows physical scarcity can dominate speculative positioning; current package lacks historical physical basis/freight data.
components.next_test: inventory surprise, curve, physical premium, freight, storage and signed hedging panel.

components.evidence: Market-specific observable can identify persistent inventory transfer better than generic OI, but historical ticker-broker data are absent.
components.next_test: point-in-time broker persistence, crossing, foreign flow, free float/controller and done-detail tests.

components.evidence: Official APIs expose relevant fields but history is limited unless prospectively archived. Synthetic controls verify the test harness only.
components.next_test: multi-venue archival panel with OI, funding, basis, taker flow, depth, side-specific liquidation and spot/on-chain origin.
